title: Load-dependent theta-gamma coupling
disposition_reason: The delivered programme scores numerical reconstruction of a declared prospective PAC analysis and its support/perturbation diagnostics. It does not score biological truth or scientific reasoning. Preserve this as measurement reconstruction; a new predictive or independently reviewed interpretation endpoint would be needed for a broader neural-understanding claim.

scientific_target.question: Can an investigator or frozen programme correctly recover the specified patient-level load and correctness PAC contrasts,including nuisance matching,unsupported cases and control diagnostics,from permitted retrospective recordings and grouping labels?
scientific_target.known_answer: Independent implementations R1/R2 define the expected numerical corrected-MI and companion outputs for the frozen prospective estimator. Supported values and null/support statuses are the known answers; the presence or sign of a biological memory mechanism is not.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Recomputation on source observations under the explicit benchmark estimator,after independent-reference agreement. The source paper selected PAC helper is not a full-cohort gold and the prospective correctness contrast is not a reproduced author primary endpoint.
scientific_target.case_unit: One patient case yields four rows(two designs×two contrasts); the complete report retains144 patient rows for36 people and four group rows.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Patient;44 sessions and channels/units/trials/frequency pairs are nested.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective signal-analysis reconstruction and nuisance sensitivity. Load,correctness,probe membership and original order are allowed grouping variables,so this is not future-behavior prediction. Native T0 still permits Python,array and signal primitives and is not no-tools.
exclusions: No native-understanding,causal PAC mechanism,or neural-contribution scalar from reconstruction MAE.
No claim of source-exact author PAC reproduction or measured complete-cohort support.

inputs: Eligible hippocampal LFP/spike hierarchy and retrospective load,correctness,probe and order variables required for the declared grouping/matching design.
Fixed half-open2.5s maintenance epochs,1000 samples at400Hz; prospective estimator uses theta centres4/6Hz,gamma centres70:5:140Hz,18 phase bins and endpoint padding.
Observed O and named perturbations D/A preserve the declared eligible hierarchy; T0 numerical primitives and T1 extra low-level signal tools are separately budgeted.
forbidden_inputs: Private reference reports,complete-answer services,source result lookup or evaluation feedback before all candidate reports are frozen.
Replacing unavailable support with fabricated zero effects,lowering trial floors after outcomes or silently switching accuracy to response time.
Calling D a PAC-destroying manipulation or A a removal of every structural eligibility cue.
observation_contract.case_identity: Complete public roster requires36 opaque24-hex patient IDs with144 patient rows and four group rows. Exact authentic issued IDs/eligible source hierarchy remain external; each case report contains all four design×contrast rows.
observation_contract.split: This is reconstruction on observed retrospective cases,not a train/test prediction split. Labels are grouping variables. Freeze estimator,eligibility,clinical/artifact review,matching,surrogates and all report axes before outcomes; preserve all patients including unsupported ones.
observation_contract.coverage: Two designs(count-only,nuisance-matched) and two contrasts(correct load3−load1; correctness difference within each load averaged equally) are mandatory. At least10 matched pairs per comparison; accuracy needs at least10 incorrect trials at each load. Eight access/perturbation cells and288 person executions remain conditions of one task; authentic support is unobserved.

primary.name: Equal-endpoint mean absolute reconstruction error in nuisance-matched corrected MI
primary.aggregation: For each of the two contrasts,average absolute error equally across reference-supported patients only after exact support agreement; then equal mean of endpoints. If either endpoint has no reference support,the primary is null. All unsupported/mismatched patients remain reported.
primary.rationale: Matches what program.grade.compare actually measures: accurate numerical analysis and support accounting. This is not an effect-size reward,predictive score or scientific-reasoning grade.

secondary: Support/status agreement for every patient/design/contrast and full reference agreement before scoring.
Eleven reported contrasts: corrected/raw MI,trial-null,shift-null,early/late MI,theta/gamma power,firing rate,harmonic PLV,waveform asymmetry.
Four group effects with bootstrap intervals/sign-flip summaries as descriptive analysis outputs.
Performance changes under signal-label derangement D and signal removal A,interpreted with preserved hierarchy/cue limitations.

comparators.name: Independent full estimators R1 and R2
comparators.inputs: Identical frozen authentic eligible source epochs and retrospective grouping variables
comparators.procedure: Implemented independent reconstruction routes must agree on support,all11 metrics and group summaries before candidate grading.

comparators.name: Fixed-zero and count-only sanity references
comparators.inputs: No signal values or the count-only comparison design as declared
comparators.procedure: Source controls reveal trivial output/support behavior; they are not competent neural-analysis gold.

comparators.name: Observed versus D/A perturbation conditions
comparators.inputs: O authentic observations;D waveform+rate derangement across label associations within order/probe strata;A no signal values but retained hierarchy/order/group labels
comparators.procedure: Implemented matched perturbation design. D preserves within-waveform PAC and A preserves structural eligibility cues; neither alone establishes a scalar neural contribution.

nuisance_controls: Nuisance matching controls power,firing rate and trial support; keep count-only sensitivity separately.
Freeze30 frequency pairs and18 phase bins; do not select favorable frequencies or PAC-significant channels after evaluation.
Retain trial-null/shift-null,early/late,harmonic and waveform-asymmetry outputs; prospective padding/corrected-MI differs from author real padding and surrogate-SD z-score.
Correctness endpoint requires sufficient errors at both loads; unsupported patient status is biology/data support,not automatically actor failure.
Four group outputs require explicit multiplicity/exchangeability assumptions before inferential claims.
evaluation.uncertainty: Programme defines10000 person bootstrap draws and10000 sign flips for group contrasts. These are conditional on selected observations/estimator and unqualified until authentic support and assumptions are checked. No channel/trial/frequency-pair pseudoreplication.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require all144 patient rows and four group rows in exact axes/order,finite metrics when supported and explicit null otherwise. Support mismatch invalidates endpoint MAE; either unsupported primary contrast leaves primary null. Distinguish numerical failure from genuine non-estimability; do not change endpoint to avoid sparse errors.

implementation.scorer_target: program.grade.compare computes absolute agreement with independently reconstructed PAC metrics and returns primary_equal_endpoint_mae; neural_gain_scalar is None. Protected programme output also leaves scientific reasoning/neural contribution unscored and rejects causal/native understanding claims.
